issues.description: The 'self.llm' attribute is referenced in the 'ask' method but is never initialized in the '__init__' constructor, which will cause an AttributeError at runtime.
issues.fix: Update the __init__ method to accept and assign the llm parameter: `def __init__(self, vector_db, embedding_model, reranker, llm): self.llm = llm`.
